question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of electricity transmission and distribution lines in Spain, with voltage level, operator and status?

answer.summary: No open official Spanish dataset provides all transmission and distribution line routes with exact voltage, operator and status. Nationally, IGN Base Topográfica Nacional (BTN 0710L_LIN_ELEC via vt-btn.idee.es MVT API or CNIG GeoPackage) gives overhead routes and banded voltages (<100, 100-150, 220, 400 kV), excluding underground/submarine cables, operator and status. Official operator and exact >=50 kV voltage exist for Andalucía (MIEA WFS) and transmission status appears in schematic MITECO 2025-2030 PDFs; REE Infored (request form) and Inkolan (paid DWG) hold operator plans, while OpenStreetMap/OpenInfraMap partially covers all fields nationally.
main_caveats: IGN BTN 0710L_LIN_ELEC excludes all underground and submarine cables (lines stop at transition towers) and omits operator and status fields.
CNMC Circular 6/2025 access-capacity maps publish substation point nodes only, not line routes; none of Spain's 325 active DSOs publish open line-route GIS.
CNIG Centro de Descargas (BTN_T_Energia GeoPackage) drops automated HTTP requests (empty reply); programmatic access works via IGN/IDEE MVT tiles at vt-btn.idee.es.
ENTSO-E Grid Map explicitly warns elements are not at exact geographic coordinates; REE public GeoRED MapServer exposes only 63 sample circuits.
OpenStreetMap/OpenInfraMap maps 128,460 km in Spain (2026-11-15), but 19.5% lacks voltage tags and ~85% of lines in Madrid/Granada samples lack operator tags.
answer.confidence_reason: Verified official regulator, ministry, TSO, IGN/IDEE, regional WFS, ENTSO-E, OSM/OpenInfraMap, and Inkolan endpoints directly with live queries and file downloads.

attributes.gap_note: No open national source gives exact kV for all distribution tiers (<100 kV); IGN BTN groups all lines below 100 kV and 100-150 kV into coarse bands.

attributes.gap_note: Outside Andalucía (>=50 kV) and statutory TSO REE, open GIS datasets lack distribution operator names across Spain's 325 active DSOs.

attributes.note: IGN BTN and Andalucía MIEA lack status; MITECO 2025-2030 PDF shows existing/planned/retired schematically; ENTSO-E marks Under Construction; OSM tags construction.
attributes.gap_note: No open national GIS vector dataset tracks operational status for both transmission and distribution lines; distribution status is unpublished as open GIS.

steps: Fetch TileJSON metadata at https://vt-btn.idee.es/1.0.0/btn/metadata.json to confirm layer schema and zoom bounds (btn0710l_lin_elec starts at minzoom 13.5305, so request zoom 14, 15 or 16).
Compute XYZ Web Mercator tile indices for the Spanish area of interest and download https://vt-btn.idee.es/1.0.0/btn/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}.pbf (note: path order is z/y/x, not z/x/y!).
Decode the uncompressed Protocol Buffer MVT layer 'btn0710l_lin_elec' (e.g. with Python mapbox-vector-tile or GDAL/OGR) and merge line segments clipped across tile borders by geometry/tensi_0710.

Alternatively, for unclipped national GeoPackage (BTN_T_Energia.gpkg) or provincial Shapefiles, use an interactive browser at https://centrodedescargas.cnig.es/CentroDescargas/btn (the CNIG download portal drops automated HTTP clients).
reading_traps: MVT URL order is /{z}/{y}/{x}.pbf (latitude/row y before longitude/column x), reversed from typical /{z}/{x}/{y} tile schemes.
btn0710l_lin_elec only appears at zoom >= 14 (minzoom 13.5305) and tiles with no overhead lines omit the layer entirely.
tensi_0710 groups all distribution voltages below 100 kV into '01 < 100 kV' and 110/132/150 kV into '02 100-150 kV'; exact kV is unavailable.
Underground and submarine cables are completely absent because BTN stops overhead lines at the transition tower.
Tile geometries are clipped at tile boundaries and integer-quantized to 4096 extent.

test.content_type: application/octet-stream (MVT PBF); text/html empty reply on CNIG download portal
problems: Secondary direct-download portal https://centrodedescargas.cnig.es/CentroDescargas/btn rejects automated HTTP clients with empty reply (curl error 52 via BigIP).

how_to_use.example_result: MVT layer power_line (170 features in tile 12/2005/1590 near Caparacena: 162 with voltage, 25 with operator, 0 construction); sample: {'osm_id': 1385729176, 'name': 'Línea de alta tensión Caparacena - Fargue', 'operator': 'Red Eléctrica de España', 'voltage': 220.0, 'type': 'line', 'construction': False, 'circuits': 1, 'coords[:2]': [[-3.725352, 37.267291], [-3.724387, 37.267359]]}.
steps: For bulk nationwide vector analysis without tile clipping, download spain-latest.osm.pbf (1.5 GB, >100 MB) and africa/canary-islands-latest.osm.pbf (60.5 MB) from Geofabrik and filter ways/relations with power in (line, minor_line, cable) or construction:power=* using osmium-tool.

For lightweight regional API queries, fetch MVT tiles from https://openinframap.org/map/power/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf (layer 'power_line') or count/query historical coverage via https://api.ohsome.org/v1/elements/count.
Note that raw OSM ways store voltage in Volts separated by semicolons for multi-voltage lines (e.g. '220000;132000'), whereas OpenInfraMap tiles convert voltage to kV floats.
reading_traps: Geofabrik spain-latest.osm.pbf omits the Canary Islands (listed separately at africa/canary-islands-latest.osm.pbf).
In tested samples, operator was missing on 85.3% of lines in tile 12/2005/1590 (25/170) and 85.8% of power=line ways in Madrid (33/232 via Ohsome, 0/173 for minor_line).
Overpass API mirrors (overpass-api.de, kumi.systems, private.coffee, maps.mail.ru) failed to connect or timed out during testing; use Geofabrik PBF or OpenInfraMap MVT tiles instead.
Compare OSM lengths carefully against REE: OSM maps physical tower corridors (1 way for a double-circuit line), whereas REE counts circuit-km (>46,000 km).

problems: Overpass API endpoints timed out or refused connection; verified via OpenInfraMap MVT tiles, OpenInfraMap Spain stats, Ohsome count API (Madrid bbox), and Geofabrik HEAD check.

regulator.name: Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC)

operators.note: Under Ley 24/2013 Art. 34.2, Red Eléctrica de España, S.A.U. (REE / Redeia) acts as sole statutory transmission operator (TSO) in exclusivity (with limited ministry-authorized DSO exceptions in secondary transmission). Distribution (<220 kV) is fragmented across 325 active operators in CNMC's census (366 rows incl. 41 Baja) and 326 in MITECO's GECOS Registry, led by 5 major groups (i-DE/Iberdrola, e-distribución/Endesa, UFD/Naturgy, Viesgo, E-REDES/EDP) plus ~300 small local distributors (grouped in CIDE and ASEME).

publication_obligation.norm: Ley 24/2013 del Sector Eléctrico (Art. 33.9, 34, 38-40); CNMC Circular informativa 6/2025 (BOE-A-2025-20259); Real Decreto 1955/2000
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: No statutory obligation found requiring operators to publish open GIS line-route geometries. Ley 24/2013 Art. 33.9 and CNMC Circular 6/2025 mandate monthly reporting and publication of substation UTM coordinates and node access capacity only; RD 1955/2000 publishes individual line authorizations in official gazettes.
publication_obligation.frequency: Monthly for substation capacity maps; no schedule for line routes

consolidated_republication.note: No public regulator or ministry republishes consolidated operator line-route GIS. IGN independently captures visible overhead power lines topographically in BTN (from PNOA/photogrammetry and regional BTA), while Inkolan is a commercial B2B consortium serving DWG plans for a fee.

checked_pages.saw: Publishes monthly ArcGIS Experience demand and generation capacity maps showing substation point layers only (esriGeometryPoint), no line geometries.
IDE download directory lists water, biodiversity, environmental quality, climate, coasts, demographic challenge and AEMET stations; no electricity grid layer.
Public registry of 326 electricity distribution companies (name, address, municipality, province, registration ID); no network geometry.
Directs external users seeking line locations to Infored request portal ('Portal para las solicitudes de información sobre las líneas propiedad de la compañía').
OGC API Features serves 38 INSPIRE collections (AD, ELU, LC, HY, TN including ropeway cablewaylink) with no Utility Services / electricity network collection.

national_registry.note: No single public official registry covers both transmission and distribution routes with voltage, operator and status. IGN's Base Topográfica Nacional (BTN 0710L_LIN_ELEC) provides official national overhead geometries and banded voltage (excluding underground/submarine cables, operator and status); REE maintains internal GeoRED transmission GIS accessible externally via individual Infored requests; distribution networks are held separately by 325 active DSOs.

checked_pages.saw: Monthly ArcGIS capacity maps under Circular 6/2025 contain substation points (Demanda_en_Transporte_v2, Demanda_en_Distribucion, Generacion_en_Transporte, Generacion_en_Distribucion) with no line routes.
Describes binding national transmission planning under Ley 24/2013 Art. 4; annexes publish schematic PDF maps (e.g. 2025-2030 Annex III), not GIS vector datasets.
States Spain's transmission grid has >46,000 km of circuits (400/220 kV mainland; 220/132/66 kV islands) and links to Infored request portal; public GeoRED exposes only 63 sample circuits.
Technical specification for BTN 0710L_LIN_ELEC (overhead lines nationwide in BTN_T_Energia GeoPackage and vt-btn.idee.es MVT tiles; excludes underground lines, operator and status).

recipe: 1. Search BOE (https://www.boe.es/buscar/) or regional official gazettes (for intra-regional <220 kV distribution lines) using terms 'autorización administrativa', 'línea eléctrica', and 'utilidad pública' to collect authorization resolutions and determine operational/construction status.

2. From each resolution (HTML text at https://www.boe.es/diario_boe/txt.php?id=<BOE-ID>), parse the 'Primero' technical block to extract operator, Tensión nominal (kV), Longitud (km), N.º de circuitos, and origin/destination substations or support numbers.

3. When Declaración de Utilidad Pública (DUP) is included (e.g. BOE-A-2026-19932 Anexo II), extract the tabular list of affected cadastral parcels (Polígono, Parcela, Referencia catastral, Término municipal).

4. For new projects in environmental review without a BOE DUP table yet, query MITECO SABIA (navServicioContenido) by title/region to retrieve project code, procedural status, and consultation documents.
if_unstructured.location_method: Extract the ordered sequence of affected 14/20-character cadastral parcel references (Referencia catastral, e.g. '49146A00100008') from Anexo II of BOE/regional DUP notices, resolve parcel geometries via Sede Electrónica del Catastro (https://www.sedecatastro.gob.es/OVCInicio.aspx), and verify pylon bases and overhead spans visually over IGN PNOA Máxima Actualidad WMTS orthophotos (https://www.ign.es/wmts/pnoa-ma?REQUEST=GetCapabilities&SERVICE=WMTS).
cross_with: IGN BTN 0710L_LIN_ELEC (https://vt-btn.idee.es/1.0.0/btn/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}.pbf) and 0716P_TOR_ALT_TEN (pylons) to match existing overhead route geometries to operators/voltages extracted from BOE/SABIA.

CNMC Circular 6/2025 substation feature layers (https://www.cnmc.es/sectores-que-regulamos/energia/supervision-del-mercado-electrico/informe-acceso-y-conexion-redes) to verify substation names, UTM coordinates and GESTOR_RED (DSO/TSO) endpoints.

MITECO GECOS Distributor Registry (https://energia.serviciosmin.gob.es/Gecos/DatosPublicos/ConsultaRegistro) and CNMC census (https://sede.cnmc.gob.es/listado/censo/1) to normalize DSO legal names and R1-xxx registration codes.

where_published.name: Boletín Oficial del Estado (BOE) — Energy Authorizations & DUP Resolutions
where_published.what: Official authorizations (Autorización Administrativa Previa, de Construcción, and Declaración de Utilidad Pública) for transmission lines (>132/220/400 kV or interregional) and large generation evacuation lines, detailing operator, voltage, length, circuit count, start/end supports/substations, status, and Anexo II cadastral parcel tables.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Open https://www.boe.es/buscar/ ('Todo el BOE' or 'Otras Disposiciones'), search quoted phrases such as '"autorización administrativa de construcción" "línea aérea" "kV"' plus company or province name; note results require manual or script filtering across notices.

example_document.what_it_gives: BOE-A-2026-19932 (2026-09-03): Operator 'Red Eléctrica de España, SAU'; Voltage 'Tensión nominal: 400 kV' / 'Tensión más elevada de la red: 420 kV'; Length & circuits 'Longitud: 0,190 km', 'N.º de circuitos: 2'; Status 'autorización administrativa previa' + 'autorización administrativa de construcción' + 'declarar, en concreto, la utilidad pública'; Endpoints 'Origen de la línea: apoyo 205N de la L/400kV Grijota-Villarino 2' to 'futura SE Moreruela 400 kV'; ANEXO II parcel table '1 | 1 | 8 | 49146A00100008 | Moreruela de los Infanzones (Zamora)'.

where_published.name: MITECO SABIA — Consulta pública de evaluaciones ambientales
where_published.what: National Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) project database publishing active and historical files for overhead/underground power lines and generation evacuation lines, including project code, promoter/operator, Autonomous Community, and procedural status.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Filter by Comunidad Autónoma (dropdown or map), project type ('select_tipo'), promoter ('select_promotor'), procedural stage ('select_estado_tramitacion'), project code ('codigo') or free-text title ('titulo'); public consultation highlights are also listed directly at https://sede.miteco.gob.es/portal/site/seMITECO/navSabiaDestacados.

example_document.what_it_gives: Highlighted public consultation list showing e.g. code '20260258': 'PRÓRROGA DE LA DIA DEL PROYECTO PLANTAS FOTOVOLTAICAS QUILLA SOLAR, DE 74 MWP, PORTALÓN SOLAR, DE 74 MWP Y SPINNAKER SOLAR, DE 50,50 MWP, ASÍ COMO SUS INFRAESTRUCTURAS DE EVACUACIÓN ASOCIADAS, EN LA PROVINCIA DE MADRID', 'Fecha de fin de consultas 2026-12-28'.
